title: 12 Best Food Halls in Adelaide
description: Discover Adelaide's top food halls and markets for diverse cuisines, from gourmet delights to budget-friendly eats. Find the best spots for every taste and occasion in 2026.

places.name: Adelaide Central Market
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A pasta dish from Lucia's Fine Foods, fresh oysters from Samtass Seafood, or a borek from The Turkish Delight Cafe.

places.name: Plant 4 Bowden
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A vegan burger from The Plant Based Brother, wood-fired pizza from San Jose, or a craft beer from a rotating tap.

places.name: The Market Shed on Holland
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A gourmet toastie, a vibrant acai bowl, or specialty coffee and a raw dessert.

places.name: Piazza Food Hall (University of Adelaide Hub)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A customisable poke bowl, a hearty Korean BBQ dish, or fresh sushi rolls.

places.name: Rundle Place Food Court
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A gourmet burger from a specialty vendor, a fresh salad from a health-focused stall, or Vietnamese pho.

places.name: Adelaide Arcade Food Court
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A steaming bowl of pho, fresh sushi or sashimi, or a gourmet sandwich.

places.name: UniSA City West Campus Food Court (City West Hub)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A custom-built burrito bowl, a warming ramen, or a fresh juice and wrap combination.

places.name: Franklin Street Food Court
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A hearty laksa, a fresh banh mi, or a generous plate of fried rice.

places.name: The Strand Arcade Food Court
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Malaysian char kway teow, sweet and sour pork, or a classic chicken schnitzel.

places.name: Morphett Street Food Court
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A huge plate of dumplings, a spicy Korean bibimbap, or a large bowl of noodle soup.

places.name: Brickworks Marketplace Food Court
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Rotisserie chicken with chips, a fresh sushi pack, or a gourmet hot dog.

places.name: Gawler Place Food Court
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A classic burger and fries, a freshly made sandwich, or a Chinese noodle dish.
